name: Card
purpose: A box that groups one item: a title, a short text, and optionally a link to more.
whenToUse: A list of items that each lead somewhere

states.how: :hover on an interactive card strengthens its border
:has(:focus-visible) draws the focus ring around the whole card

props.name: href
props.does: Makes the title a link whose click area covers the card

props.name: headingLevel
props.does: Fits the card's heading into the page outline

keyboard.action: Reaches the title link, then any other link in the card

accessibility.web: Only the title is a link, so a screen reader hears the title, not the whole card. Other links inside stay separately reachable.
accessibility.ios: A VStack with an accessibility element for the title link
accessibility.android: A Compose Card with the title as the clickable element

content: A short, specific title, then one or two sentences.
